toegepas.voor: Albei sit 'n hele groep in een boks.
toegepas.na: Albei druk 'n hele groep in een hokkie.
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'In een boks sit' is an English idiom; the Afrikaans idiom is 'iemand in 'n hokkie druk'.
toegepas.fout: 'in een boks sit' copies the English 'put in a box'
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'In een hokkie druk' is the Afrikaans idiom for the same stereotyping image, and the meaning is unchanged.

toegepas.voor: 'n grap of opmerking wees wat iemand klein maak
toegepas.na: 'n grap of opmerking wees wat iemand afkraak
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Iemand klein maak' calques 'make someone small'; 'afkraak' is the natural verb and matches the lesson's own definition of seksisme.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Afkraak' is the natural verb for belittling and matches the lesson's own seksisme definition, so the meaning holds.

toegepas.voor: wat wil dans en sê dis 'n meisiesding
toegepas.na: wat wil dans, en hulle sê dit is 'n meisiesding
toegepas.rede_vinder: As written, 'sê' can attach to the boy inside the relative clause; naming the subject makes clear the mates say it, takes the AWS comma, and 'dit is' matches the lesson's register.
toegepas.fout: 'wat wil dans en se' lets 'se' attach to the boy inside the relative clause
toegepas.rede_keurder: Naming 'hulle' makes clear the mates say it, and the AWS comma correctly joins two clauses with their own subject and verb.

toegepas.voor: mishandeling is wanneer iemand 'n ander mens seermaak, bang maak
toegepas.na: mishandeling is wanneer iemand 'n ander mens seermaak, bangmaak
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Bangmaak' is one compound verb, like 'seermaak' beside it.
toegepas.fout: 'bang maak' is written apart where the word list has the compound 'bangmaak'
toegepas.rede_keurder: Plain spelling fix that matches 'seermaak' beside it; the protected 'afsny om mag' wording is untouched.

toegepas.voor: Wanneer iemand 'n ander mens seermaak, bang maak
toegepas.na: Wanneer iemand 'n ander mens seermaak, bangmaak
toegepas.rede_vinder: Same compound-verb spelling in the glossary so it matches the study text; this voor is unique only with the capital W, so if matching ignores case it should go to the writer instead.
toegepas.fout: same split compound 'bang maak' in the glossary entry
toegepas.rede_keurder: A plain spelling fix in a non-shared glossary entry, which keeps it matching the study text; if the locator cannot find it uniquely it should fail and go to the writer rather than be forced.

toegepas.voor: Om te dreig om iemand seer te maak is ook
toegepas.na: Om te dreig om iemand seer te maak, is ook
toegepas.rede_vinder: A comma after a long opening om-te subject clause marks where the subject ends and helps the reader; the protected wording stays intact.
toegepas.fout: two om-te clauses run straight into 'is ook', so the reader stumbles on where the subject ends
toegepas.rede_keurder: The comma after the long om-te subject is allowed by the AWS and helps a Grade 6 reader, and the protected wording stays intact.

toegepas.blok: Wat dit aan vriende en gesinne doen
toegepas.na: wanneer iets die seun seermaak nie
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Hom' can refer to the friend, who is the subject of the sentence, rather than the boy.
toegepas.fout: 'hom' can point to the friend, the subject of the sentence, instead of the boy
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Die seun' removes the ambiguity without changing who is hurt.

toegepas.blok: Wat dit aan 'n klas of 'n span doen
toegepas.voor: nie meer saam nie en 'n seun sing
toegepas.na: nie meer saam nie, en 'n seun sing
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'En' joins two sentences that each have their own subject and verb, so the AWS takes a comma.
toegepas.fout: missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subject and verb
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'n Meisie bou' and 'n seun sing' are two full clauses, so the comma is required.

toegepas.rede_vinder: In the sense of withdrawing from people the verb is reflexive: 'hulle terugtrek'.
toegepas.fout: 'terugtrek' in the sense of withdrawing from people is reflexive and is missing 'hulle'
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Trek hulle terug' is the correct form for social withdrawal, and the meaning is unchanged.

toegepas.blok: Wat jy aan stereotipes en seksisme kan doen
toegepas.voor: 'n grap wat iemand klein maak nie
toegepas.rede_vinder: Same calque as earlier in the lesson; 'afkraak' is natural and matches the seksisme definition.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Same fix as change 2, keeping the lesson consistent with its seksisme definition.

laat_vaar.blok: Wat dit aan 'n klas of 'n span doen
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Gewoon word' reads awkwardly and is easily confused with 'gewoond'; 'iets gewoons word' says it becomes normal.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Gewoon word' is grammatical and clear, and the proposal repeats 'iets' already used earlier in the same sentence ('verloor iets').

laat_vaar.blok: Wat dit aan 'n klas of 'n span doen
laat_vaar.na: wie die volgende keer uitgelag sal word
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: Bare adverbial 'volgende' calques 'who is next'; 'die volgende keer ... sal word' is natural Afrikaans for a future event.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: Adverbial 'volgende' is normal Afrikaans and the original reads well; the proposal is longer without being clearly better.

laat_vaar.voor: 'n kind se werk om dit te stop
laat_vaar.na: 'n kind se werk om dit stop te sit
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Stopsit' is the more natural Afrikaans for putting an end to something ongoing; meaning unchanged.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: Transitive 'stop' (to make something end) is standard Afrikaans and plain for Grade 6, so 'stopsit' is a lateral move in a sentence about who is responsible.

laat_vaar.na: grootmense om dit stop te sit
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: Same verb as the previous sentence so the pair stays parallel.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: Dropped together with change 13, so the pair stays parallel with 'stop'.

na_skrywer.voor: Dit tel steeds as jy eers lank later vertel.
na_skrywer.na: Dit is steeds reg om te vertel, al is dit eers lank later.
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: 'Dit tel steeds' calques 'it still counts'; the rewrite keeps 'vertel' and the meaning that telling late is still right.
na_skrywer.fout: 'Dit tel steeds' may read as a calque of 'it still counts' (check)
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: This sentence is a safety instruction about telling, and the proposal shifts 'it still counts' (still taken seriously) to 'it is still right' (permission), so the writer must decide whether there is a fault and how to word it.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

vlae.teks: Mishandeling laat sommige mense bang word en ander mense minder vertrou.
vlae.rede: Ambiguous: it can mean the same people become afraid and trust others less, or that other people (a second group) come to trust less. Fixing it would mean guessing which is meant, so the writer should decide.
